_comments.dual_powers: dual_powers is formatted as namespace:power no matter what your power format is
_comments.power_format: Valid variables are ${namespace}, ${power} and ${slots}, ${slots} is only used when Ability Replication from heroes is rolled
_comments.slots_format: Valid variables are ${count} and ${s}, ${s} just adds an s if there are more than one slots (eg. 'with ${count} slot${s})
